package.description: A desktop application that streamlines file management by syncing files to the cloud while understanding design file relationships.

en-US.description: A desktop application that streamlines file management by syncing files to the cloud while understanding design file relationships.
en-US.longDescription:
Desktop Connector seamlessly integrates with your device, enabling you to sync, manage, and access local and cloud files effortlessly. It preserves file relationships and references, ensuring design integrity and reducing errors. With Desktop Connector, you can:
- Visualize complex file references
- Maintain up-to-date project information
- Streamline collaboration across your team
en-US.name: Autodesk Desktop Connector

zh-CN.description: 一款桌面应用程序，通过将文件同步到云端并理解设计文件之间的关系，从而简化文件管理。
zh-CN.longDescription:
桌面连接器可无缝集成到您的设备中，轻松实现本地文件与云端文件的同步、管理和访问。它能够保留文件之间的关联和引用关系，确保设计完整性并减少错误。使用桌面连接器，您可以：
- 直观查看复杂的文件引用关系
- 保持项目信息实时更新
- 简化团队间的协作流程
